title: CodeJeNN: A simple C++ neural network generator for physics applications
abstract: arXiv:2607.02746v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning has shown promise for physics applications, but integrating Python-based libraries into high-performance C++ solvers can create performance bottlenecks. We present CodeJeNN, which addresses this gap by auto-generating self-contained C++ code from trained Keras models for inference. This eliminates external dependencies through inlined functions, allowing seamless integration into existing frameworks. We describe the Keras-to-C++ workflow, supported architectures, and limitations. CodeJeNN is demonstrated through inference benchmarks against Keras (eager and optimized) and a computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation of a hydrogen-air mixing layer in which viscosity is modeled using a neural network, showing that the generated models integrate directly into a solver while remaining efficient and accurate.

translated_title: CodeJeNN：一个面向物理应用的简单C++神经网络生成器
translated_abstract: 机器学习在物理应用中已展现出前景，但将基于Python的库集成到高性能C++求解器中可能会造成性能瓶颈。我们提出了CodeJeNN，它通过从训练好的Keras模型自动生成自包含的C++推理代码来填补这一空白。该方法通过内联函数消除了外部依赖，实现了与现有框架的无缝集成。我们描述了Keras到C++的工作流程、所支持的架构以及局限性。通过与Keras（即时执行模式和优化模式）的推理基准测试，以及一项氢气-空气混合层的计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟——其中粘度由神经网络建模——对CodeJeNN进行了演示，结果表明生成的模型能够直接集成到求解器中，同时保持高效和准确。
tldr: CodeJeNN能将训练好的Keras模型自动生成为无外部依赖的自包含C++推理代码，使神经网络可高效、无缝地集成到高性能物理模拟求解器中。
en_tdlr: CodeJeNN auto-generates self-contained, dependency-free C++ inference code from trained Keras models, enabling efficient and seamless integration of neural networks into high-performance physics solvers.
